author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Barracuda patched two flaws that can be chained to give attackers root access to Email Security Gateway appliances. author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Cyberattacks disrupted refrigeration monitoring systems at three French blood banks, amid similar attacks targeting European supermarkets. title: Cyberattack Hits French Blood Banks as Hackers Target Refrigeration Systems Across Europe
